verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents API access tokens, webhooks, a CLI and an MCP server, but nothing on API versioning or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe found no published spec at the tested paths. Versioned APIs are a fair axis for a SaaS platform like this, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
